description: The acceptance suites and the tests that make up each one. `pnpm test:acceptance` runs them and reports pass or fail per suite (scripts/acceptance-report.mjs). A suite passes only when every listed file ran and every test in it passed; a skipped test makes the suite incomplete, which the report treats as a failure. `requires` says which live service a suite needs: `none` means it runs anywhere, and the other values mark the checks that only a deployed environment can make (reported, not run).

suites.name: Moodle connectivity
suites.proves: The client reaches a Moodle web-service endpoint, keeps the token out of URLs, classifies rejected tokens and throttling, and refuses undocumented response shapes.

suites.name: Course discovery
suites.proves: Only selected, visible courses and activities are discovered, and hidden or unavailable material is excluded.

suites.name: File downloading
suites.proves: Activity files are fetched from the token-authenticated pluginfile endpoint within the size limit.

suites.name: Content extraction
suites.proves: Supported formats yield text with page or slide numbers; unsupported and unreadable files are quarantined rather than indexed empty.

suites.name: Chunking
suites.proves: Chunks respect the target size, carry heading paths and page or slide metadata, and are numbered within the resource.

suites.name: Embedding
suites.proves: Chunks are embedded in batches at the configured dimensions, cached by content hash, and re-embedded when the model or version changes.

suites.name: Indexing
suites.proves: Chunks reach the index with their Moodle metadata, and a resource's surplus chunks are removed when it shrinks.

suites.name: Retrieval quality
suites.proves: Indexed content is retrievable for the question that it answers, and retrieval never crosses a course boundary. Ranking against real E-Hub content is measured by `pnpm evaluation:retrieval` against a deployment.

suites.name: Grounded answer quality
suites.proves: Claims without support are removed, invented numbers, pages, documents and links are rejected, and an unanswerable question gets the fixed insufficient-evidence reply. See docs/acceptance.md for what grounding does not prove.

suites.name: Citation accuracy
suites.proves: Every citation maps to a retrieved chunk and carries the real course, section, resource, page or slide and URL.

suites.name: Teams rendering
suites.proves: Answer, welcome and error cards are valid Adaptive Cards, and hostile text cannot become a link, action or template expression.

suites.name: Entra authentication
suites.proves: Only tokens with the expected issuer, audience, signature, lifetime and tenant are accepted, and failure is closed.

suites.name: Moodle course authorization
suites.proves: Retrieval is limited to the signed-in user's Moodle enrolments for every case in tests/evaluation/authorization-cases.json, and an unavailable Moodle fails closed.

suites.name: Prompt injection
suites.proves: The attacks in tests/evaluation/security-cases.json cannot change the assistant's instructions, widen access or leak credentials.

suites.name: Deleted-content cleanup
suites.proves: Deleted, hidden and deselected content stops being answerable, while the deletion guard prevents an outage from emptying the index.

suites.name: Incremental synchronization
suites.proves: Unchanged content is skipped without embedding cost, changed and new content is picked up, and a pipeline version change forces a re-index.

suites.name: Failure recovery
suites.proves: Moodle, index and lease failures leave the last good answers in place and recover without operator surgery.

suites.name: Monitoring and redaction
suites.proves: Jobs and answers emit structured JSON with correlation IDs and counts, carrying no credentials, questions or document text, and sync lag is reported.

suites.name: Content update, end to end
suites.proves: Prompt 18's end-to-end check: index version 1, answer from it, replace the source, re-sync, prove version 1's chunks are gone, and answer from version 2.

suites.name: Live Moodle reachability
suites.proves: The configured E-Hub server answers core_webservice_get_site_info with the deployed token, so the web service, the account and the token all work.

suites.name: Live Azure Search and model
suites.proves: The deployed search index, embedding deployment and chat deployment all answer with the deployed identity, and the state stores are reachable.

suites.name: Live retrieval and answer evaluation
suites.proves: Retrieval and answer cases score against the real index and model rather than fakes.

suites.name: Teams and Entra sign-in
suites.proves: A staff member can install the personal app, sign in with Entra SSO and get an answer with working citation links.
suites.command: manual: see docs/acceptance.md, "Checks that need a deployment"
